title: LockApp
tagline: B2B SaaS for Indian phone retailers to remotely manage Android devices sold on EMI
role: Full-Stack Architecture, Android Device Owner Client & Cloud Backend
description: LockApp is an enterprise-grade mobile device management and EMI payment compliance platform built for electronics retailers, smartphone distributors, and non-banking financial companies (NBFCs). The system couples an Android device administrator agent with a resilient cloud control plane to protect financed hardware assets.
challenge: Electronics retailers and financing firms face significant default risks when financing smartphones without collateral. Customers can remove SIM cards, turn off Wi-Fi, or attempt hardware resets to evade payment obligations, rendering standard cloud-based locks ineffective.
solution: Vesharo engineered a dual-layer MDM architecture combining a low-level Android Kotlin Device Owner lock app with a distributed Node.js/Express backend on Railway with MongoDB Atlas. FCM lock/unlock signals are coupled with Fast2SMS fallback triggers, ensuring offline policy enforcement even when network connectivity is severed.
architecture: Kotlin Android Enterprise Device Owner client with persistent watchdog
Event-driven Node.js & Express backend managing fleet telemetry and policy states
MongoDB Atlas cluster with tenant-isolated retailer reporting and audit trails
Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) with automated Fast2SMS fallback triggers
metrics: Real-time remote device policy sync across multi-tenant retailer accounts
Tamper-resistant offline lock enforcement preventing unauthorized bypass
Centralized retailer administration dashboard with automated EMI reconciliation

title: NavratriOS
tagline: Multi-tenant SaaS digitizing Navratri festival registration and gate entry in Gujarat
status: Piloted at Gujarat Venues & In Production
role: High-Concurrency Backend, Offline QR Protocol & Scanner App
description: NavratriOS is a high-throughput ticketing and gate-entry management SaaS platform engineered to manage massive crowds at large cultural festivals and venues in Gujarat. Built for thousands of scans at peak, it delivers sub-second QR pass verification, instant anti-passback protection, and real-time crowd telemetry.
challenge: During large-scale multi-day cultural events, venue gates experience massive rushes of tens of thousands of attendees arriving within a narrow 90-minute window. Network connectivity at crowded physical gates is frequently congested, leading to scanner freezes, long entry queues, and ticketing fraud.
solution: Vesharo architected a modular Node.js/Express backend backed by MongoDB and an offline-tolerant QR verification protocol. Handheld React Native/Expo gate scanners locally validate cryptographically signed QR tokens in under 200ms while asynchronously batch-syncing validation logs with the central server.
architecture: Modular Node.js/Express API architecture built for thousands of scans at peak
React Native & Expo handheld mobile scanner app with offline QR cryptography
MongoDB database cluster with in-memory anti-passback verification checks
Real-time administrative web portals for organizers and garba classes
metrics: Sub-second gate validation via handheld scanners under dense crowd conditions
Zero-downtime registration spikes under heavy evening ticketing rushes
Real-time attendance analytics and pass management across multi-gate perimeters

title: Wirebench
tagline: Private API client with one-click Postman migration, drift detection & team changelog
role: Core Architecture, Schema Diffing Engine & Desktop Client
description: Wirebench is a lightweight, privacy-first API testing and documentation workbench built for distributed engineering teams. It offers one-click migration from Postman, Insomnia, and Hoppscotch, continuously monitors live endpoint contracts against OpenAPI schemas, and flags breaking schema regressions.
challenge: As engineering teams scale microservices independently, subtle API contract drift—such as altered nullability, renamed response keys, or type shifts—routinely slips past unit tests, causing silent breakages across downstream web and mobile applications.
solution: Vesharo built Wirebench as an offline-capable, local-first API workbench that executes contract diffing directly on developer machines or within private VPC CI pipelines. It generates automated visual diffs and markdown changelogs with zero third-party cloud data exposure.
architecture: Local-first Electron & TypeScript desktop client with SQLite persistence
Automated schema comparison engine evaluating live JSON against OpenAPI 3.1 specs
One-click lossless importer for Postman collections, Insomnia, and Hoppscotch
Zero-telemetry privacy design ensuring proprietary API credentials never leave the machine
metrics: Automated contract-drift alerting preventing breaking client regressions
Zero cloud data leaks — operates completely locally or in private VPCs
Integrated markdown changelog generation streamlining cross-squad releases

title: MedMarketMD
tagline: B2B medical supplies procurement & inventory distribution platform
description: MedMarketMD is a HIPAA-compliant B2B digital procurement platform designed for clinics, diagnostic centers, and certified pharmaceutical distributors. It centralizes bulk order purchasing, automated batch tracking, and supplier pricing agreements.
challenge: Medical procurement involves fragmented supplier catalogs, compliance certification checks, and erratic inventory lead times, leading to order delays and pricing discrepancies.
solution: Vesharo engineered a centralized B2B marketplace engine with multi-vendor role-based access, automated invoice reconciliation, and integrated cold-chain tracking telemetry.
architecture: Fastify & Node.js backend with row-level tenant security
PostgreSQL database with encrypted health provider records
Real-time stock reservation and batch tracking engine
Automated purchase order PDF generation and webhook dispatch
metrics: Automated purchase order fulfillment and audit trails
Zero-downtime procurement operations for healthcare facilities
